intro: Chicken Clucking for a Mint is a lighthearted seasonal Alliance quest offered in Ironforge during the Hallow's End festival. To earn a traditional Ironforge Mint on behalf of the young orphan Jesper, adventurers must put aside their battle-hardened dignity and flap their arms while clucking like a chicken for the tavern's amusement. Innkeeper Firebrew gladly rewards anyone willing to swallow their pride to bring holiday cheer to a child.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah, trick-or-treating for a sick child, are we? I was going to say, you're a little old to be rummaging about for candies...

Well, for my treat - an Ironforge Mint - you will need to... Cluck like a chicken! Yes, chickens love mints... Well OK, maybe they don't LOVE them... But I won't give you a mint unless you chicken cluck for me!
Well adventurer, are you up to the challenge or not?! Time to earn your treat!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Too funny! Well done, friend! Here's your treat.
